design: No clean pilot (the 3/13 partial server run is not used). Hypotheses by analogy with Task A, except for the direction of the context family, set by E1.

rationale.comp_primary: Same three pieces as Task A: number of training negatives, focal loss, adversarial weighting.
rationale.ctx_primary: The two blocks that answer a biological question on the indication task: the injected pharmacological layer (no_pharma) and the disease side of the graph (no_disease_ctx).
rationale.direction: two-sided for the context family: on Task B, E1 found that message passing over the context LOWERS every metric (DistMult 0.692 vs R-GCN 0.348), so removing context may help R-GCN. A one-sided test would presuppose the opposite.
rationale.multiplicity: Holm within each family over its primaries only (3 and 2 tests).
